title: Kali's third punishment
description: Carrying the ball Kali chained him to, the player throws a bomb at her altar, and its blast destroys it: "YOU DARE DEFILE MY ALTAR? I WILL PUNISH YOU!" The level goes dark, and a ghost comes in from the edge of the screen and drifts toward him.
